newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish steel mill, British firm form joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Polish steel mill, British firm form joint venture.

text.p: Polish steel mill Huta Sendzimira and Britain's Metal Enterprises company have signed an agreement on forming a joint venture to sell Polish steel products in Great Britain, a Polish steel mill official said.

Wojciech Siekierski, head of the state-owned Huta Sendzimira trade department said in a statement the British firm would have 51 percent in the newly formed company, called Metal Enterprises Polish Steel Products.
"Through the joint-venture Huta Sendzimira expects to boost its sales of steel products in Great Britain," Siekierski said.
The firm would start operating from 1997.
